_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/statics/test_off_battlefield_subtype.py. t_ob_nexus is Maskwood Nexus's first line narrowed to one creature type (Squirrel), so a test can tell a granted type from a printed one; t_ob_patron reads Squirrel spells two ways -- a cost reduction and a cast trigger; t_ob_bad_nexus is the same static without the flag, the battlefield-only near miss; t_ob_lord is a Squirrel anthem, whose filter must not see the grant.
